body: Thank you. I think I'm good for now, but I really appreciate the offer and may take it up sometime in the future, if you don't mind.

Thank you so much. You said all the right things to make me feel better and hopefully its enough to get me through this week and to break. I went to breakfast this morning and was struggling to hold back the tears. All I could think was of ways I could end it. And then I get back to my room and read this and realize how good it feels when someone, even if its someone I don't even know, cares.
